name: AOP Zipped Baseball Jacket
description: <p><strong>Features:</strong></p><ul><li>Zipped Baseball Jacket provides warmth in autumn/ early winter: Whether on a freezing morning or a cool night, a comfortable jacket always comes in handy. And a varsity jacket is an awesome choice that works here.</li><li>Fabric: 95% Polyester + 5% Spandex</li><li>GSM: Approximately 250g/m2</li><li>Suitable for special occasions such as Christmas, birthdays, celebrations, and housewarming gifts.</li><li>Made of polyester & cotton, this Baseball Jacket is light and keeps warm.</li><li>Heavy double-knit polyester jersey</li><li>Rounded hem</li><li>Rib-knit cuffs and collar keep their shape</li><li>PRINT: Dye-sublimation printing</li><li>WASHABLE: Machine wash cold, only non-chlorine bleach when needed, hang dry, cool iron on the reverse side, or dry clean<br> </li></ul><p><strong>Production & Shipping Information</strong></p><p><strong>Shipping time</strong>: 10 – 15 working days average (US)</p><p><strong>Processing time</strong> : 3 - 5  working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly.</p><p> </p><p><strong>NOTE:</strong></p><ul><li>Actual color may differ slightly from the image due to different monitor and light effects.</li><li>Please allow 0.5-3 cm differences due to manual measurement. </li></ul>
guideLine: <p><strong>Print Guidelines</strong></p><p>Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. </p><p>Download templates and mockups <a href="https://printway.larksuite.com/drive/folder/RDuVfpsaqlgokudEu0ouhEassad">here</a></p><p><strong>To use an Art Template:</strong></p><ul><li>Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.</li><li>Insert your artwork in a new layer, <strong>placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template</strong> to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.</li><li>If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.</li><li>Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.</li><li>Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.</li><li>You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.</li><li>Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.</li></ul><p><strong>To ensure your design prints properly on each product:</strong></p><ul><li><strong>Fill the entire design template!</strong> The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.</li><li><i><strong>Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product. </strong></i></li></ul>
